messages:
Ruth (Partnerships): Quick thread: BayBridge x Redwood live lab at CloudBridge next Fri. Need speaker confirmations, kit consolidation (partner + Redwood items), on-site fallback, and a tiny postcard coupon.
Valerie (BayBridge): Confirming speakers: Ilya (platform) + Sera (integrations). We'll ship partner dongles from our SF office.
Ethan (Field Ops): Run format: 15m joint talk, 35m rotating benches, 20m AMA. Need 4 bench leads. Volunteers?
Priya (Events): Volunteers so far: Priya, Ruth, Diego (if he can do a bench), BayBridge will provide 2 bench leads. Confirm by Wed.
Diego (Eng): I can bench lead one rotation and own demo fallback. Primary: dedicated on-prem rack; fallback: hosted model + recorded clip. I'll add a warmup curl.
Diego (Eng): Warmup command for runbook:
```
# prime runtime cache
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"prime","max_tokens":6}'
```
Marco (Supply): Kit consolidation proposal: Redwood items: power cable, sticker sheet, quickstart postcard w/ coupon; BayBridge: USB dongle + small foam case. Target qty: 160 kits carry-on. PO needed Tue 10am.
Nadia (Marketing): I'll design the postcard + landing page. Suggest coupon code BAYRED-CLBRG. Also need headshots + 1-line bio by Thu EOD.
Valerie (BayBridge): Confirm coupon code OK from partner side. We'll validate coupon on our side and create single-use merchant mapping.
pack-bot: Packing manifest template uploaded -> s3://events/baybridge/pack-manifest-template.csv sha256: f1e2d3c4.
Marco (Supply): Shipping placeholder label DHL TEMP-909. Will replace after PO & customs info. If any kits cross borders, need HS codes by Tue 3pm.
Ruth (Partnerships): On-site: pickup at venue loading dock 7:00am day-of. Bench lead huddle 7:30am. Priya will own volunteer roster.
Priya (Events): Run-through Wed 8:30am PT 8:45am quick mic check. Calendar invite sent.
calendar-bot: Invite created -> 'BayBridge x Redwood Live Lab Runthrough' Wed 08:30am PT. RSVP updated.
Diego (Eng): I'll push demo image to s3://redwood-events/baybridge/bench-image.img and post sha before Wed run-through.
Marco (Supply): Budget estimate ~ $9.2k for 160 kits incl shipping. If we scale under 160 update manifest Tue AM.
Ruth (Partnerships): Recap actions: 1) Vale -> confirm dongle ship date, 2) Marco -> PO/labels (Tue AM), 3) Nadia -> postcard + landing (Thu EOD), 4) Diego -> demo image + warmup (Wed). Ping in thread if blockers. :rocket:
